claim.statement:
For every viscosity $
u > 0$ on the dual Lie algebra $\mathfrak{g}^* = \mathrm{SDiff}(\mathbb{T}^3)^*$ with Calder'on--Zygmund constant $C_{\mathrm{CZ}} = 3/2$ and canonical tether coupling $\kappa =  rac{27 C_{\mathrm{CZ}}^4}{4
u^3} =  rac{2187}{64
u^3} > 0$, 	extbf{(P$_1$)} the quadratic density $\alpha(\omega) = -\kappa\|\omega\|^2$ is the unique minimal-degree polynomial kernel density satisfying Casimir preservation, parity/negativity, and parabolic scaling; 	extbf{(P$_2$)} the full pairing $\mathfrak{T}_F(\delta F, \delta G) = \omega_{\mathrm{KKS}}(\omega)(\delta F, \delta G) - \kappa\int_{\mathbb{T}^3} \|\omega\|^2 \langle P_{\delta C}^\perp \delta F, P_{\delta C}^\perp \delta G angle\,dx$ decomposes into an alternating Kirillov--Kostant--Souriau symplectic 2-form obeying the cyclic Jacobi identity and a symmetric negative-semidefinite metriplectic tether that vanishes on Casimir gradients ($P_{\delta C}^\perp \omega = 0$) and is strictly negative on every non-Casimir transverse perturbation ($P_{\delta C}^\perp v 
eq 0, \omega 
eq 0$); 	extbf{(P$_3$)} conjugate $(4/3, 4)$ Young absorption satisfies $C_{\mathrm{CZ}} m^3 -  rac{
u}{3} m^2 -  rac{\kappa}{4} m^6 \le 0$ for all $m \ge 0$; and 	extbf{(P$_4$)} every continuous vorticity envelope obeying $M'(t) \le C_{\mathrm{CZ}} M(t)^2 - \kappa'' M(t)^3$ ($\kappa'' > 0$) satisfies the global Lyapunov ceiling $M(t) \le \max(M(0), C_{\mathrm{CZ}}/\kappa'')$. Global regularity for general data is conditional on 	exttt{FrohmanianTetherBound}, 	exttt{KatoLocalWitness}, 	exttt{PhysicalBKMContinuationCriterionFor} and 	exttt{KatoUniquenessOnExistenceTimes}.

claim.statement: Let $\kappa > 0$, $\omega \in \mathfrak{g}^*$, and $v : \mathbb{T}^3 \to \mathbb{R}^3$. Define the pointwise tether density $d_{\mathrm{FT}}(\kappa, \omega, v, x) = -\kappa \|\omega(x)\|^2 \|P_{\delta C}^\perp v(x)\|^2$. Then: • \textbf{Diagonal non-positivity (\texttt{tetherPointwiseDensity\_nonpos}, \texttt{tetherKernel\_diagonal\_nonpos}):} $d_{\mathrm{FT}}(\kappa, \omega, v, x) \le 0$ for all $x \in \mathbb{T}^3$, and $-\kappa\,\mathcal{K}_{\mathrm{FT}}(v, v; \omega) \le 0$. • \textbf{Casimir invariance (\texttt{tether\_preserves\_casimirs}):} For any Casimir functional $C$ with $\delta C(\omega) \parallel \omega$, $\{F, C\}_{\mathrm{FT}} = \{F, C\}_{\mathrm{LP}} = 0$. • \textbf{Strict negativity on non-Casimir modes (\texttt{tetherPointwiseDensity\_strict\_neg\_of\_noncasimir}, \texttt{tetherKernel\_strict\_neg\_of\_orthogonal\_component}, \texttt{tetherKernel\_nondegenerate\_on\_casimir\_defect}):} Whenever $\omega(x) \neq 0$ and $P_{\delta C}^\perp v(x) \neq 0$, we have $d_{\mathrm{FT}}(\kappa, \omega, v, x) < 0$. Moreover, if the integrated orthogonal Casimir defect $\int_{\mathbb{T}^3} \|\omega(x)\|^2 \|P_{\delta C}^\perp v(x)\|^2\,dx > 0$, then $-\kappa\,\mathcal{K}_{\mathrm{FT}}(v, v; \omega) < 0$.
